arguments.content: P1 recovery identity pattern: retained audit records must be resolved by operation identity, not merely by target resource. In a serialized preference save, selecting the first recovery record for a workspace caused every later fresh operation ID to reuse the completed record, skip provider replacement, and return apparent success for an ID that had no audit record. Reproduced through the unchanged client on the staged service.py candidate versus HEAD feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67. Preserve operation-ID lookup and retained records; verify a fresh operation after both ordinary completion and failed-then-recovered completion.
